title: Uniform Coverage for the Causal Win Ratio When Losses Are Rare
banked_reason: D0.5.G: tier incremental below field floor; paper_score_ceiling 5.6 < 7.4; not salvageable within the operator-fixed disconnected beta class; nondegeneracy_certificate_missing@prop:boundary-coverage remains unrepaired.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the exact two-Poisson limit, a finite-sample projected interval, two same-class width obstructions, and a global Wald-coverage calculation, with direct software execution receipts. D0.5 graded the delivered package incremental, below the fixed field floor; its suggested connected beta class changes the operator-fixed question. The math referee passed, but the rubric's explicit nondegeneracy certificate for the Wald-failure node remains unproved in the banked note.
tldr: The paper gives a complete inference benchmark for the scaled independently drawn causal win ratio on a fully positive four-category triangular class. The pinned unadjusted winPSW IFM interval has the exact worst limiting coverage \(\Gamma=3/(2e)\), with minimizing set exactly \(\{(1,0,u,v):3/10\leq u\leq2/5,\ 9/20\leq v\leq11/20\}\), and no minimizer is resonant. Its center and standard error have the patient-cluster two-Poisson limit \((D^{-1},\sqrt Q/D^2)\), including the zero-loss atom, and even full-class substitution only at zero losses reaches merely \(5/(2e)<0.95\). As a coverage-facing remedy on the prespecified class, four marginal Clopper--Pearson inversions project through the exact monotone target to an everywhere-defined finite-sample \(95\%\) interval. Complete-data two-point arguments give a nonsharp two-elbow same-class width obstruction: below width \(1/5\), the within-positive-\(\beta\) pair forces probability at least \(0.7670396931\ldots\); below width \(160/153\), the declared disconnected \(\beta=0\) versus \(\beta=1\) pair forces probability at least \(0.2678794411\ldots\) and expected diameter at least \(0.2801353633\ldots\).
gap: Published unmatched win-ratio inference uses fixed-law U-statistic and delta-method asymptotics, while the implemented loss denominator can be driven by only order-one patients even though it contains \(n^2\) pair comparisons.
fill: The project reduces the pinned software center and variance to two Poisson counts, derives the discontinuous coverage envelope, certifies its computation, and poses the global minimization over the legal class as the remaining open object.
